topic: Shoulder US: diagnostic accuracy for full- and partial-thickness rotator cuff tears
title: Diagnostic accuracy of ultrasound for rotator cuff tears in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
key_points: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 62 studies (6007 patients, 6066 shoulders) comparing ultrasound with arthroscopic or open surgical findings for rotator cuff tears.
Partial-thickness tears: pooled sensitivity 0.84, specificity 0.89.
Full-thickness tears: pooled sensitivity 0.96, specificity 0.93. The authors concluded that US accuracy is superior for full-thickness than for partial-thickness tears.
The included studies described population characteristics and assessor blinding poorly and had limited sample sizes.
key_points_pt: Revisão sistemática e meta-análise de 62 estudos (6007 doentes, 6066 ombros) que comparou a ecografia com os achados cirúrgicos (artroscópicos ou abertos) nas roturas da coifa dos rotadores.
Roturas de espessura parcial: sensibilidade agregada de 0,84 e especificidade de 0,89.

Roturas de espessura total: sensibilidade agregada de 0,96 e especificidade de 0,93. Os autores concluíram que a acuidade da ecografia é superior nas roturas de espessura total em relação às de espessura parcial.
Os estudos incluídos descreviam mal as características das populações e a ocultação dos avaliadores, e tinham amostras de dimensão limitada.
abstract_excerpt: Sixty-two studies assessing 6007 patients and 6066 shoulders were included. Ultrasonography had good sensitivity and specificity for the assessment of partial thickness (sensitivity 0.84; specificity 0.89), and full-thickness rotator cuff tears (sensitivity 0.96; specificity 0.93). However, the literature poorly described population characteristics, assessor blinding, and was based on limited sample sizes. ... The diagnostic test accuracy of ultrasound is superior for the detection of full-thickness compared to partial-thickness cuff tears.

topic: Shoulder US: rotator cuff tears and tendinopathy, comparison of US vs MRI vs MR arthrography and by operator type
title: Diagnostic accuracy of ultrasonography, MRI and MR arthrography in the characterisation of rotator cuff disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
key_points: For full-thickness rotator cuff tears, diagnostic accuracy of US, MRI and MR arthrography was high, with overall estimates of sensitivity and specificity above 0.90.
For partial-thickness tears and tendinopathy, overall specificity was high (>0.90) but sensitivity was lower (0.67-0.83).
US accuracy was similar whether a trained radiologist, a sonographer or an orthopaedist performed the scan.
The authors concluded that US is the best option when accuracy, cost and safety are all considered.
key_points_pt: Nas roturas de espessura total da coifa dos rotadores, a acuidade diagnóstica da ecografia, da RM e da artro-RM foi elevada, com estimativas globais de sensibilidade e especificidade superiores a 0,90.
Nas roturas de espessura parcial e na tendinopatia, a especificidade global foi elevada (>0,90), mas a sensibilidade foi inferior (0,67-0,83).
A acuidade diagnóstica da ecografia foi semelhante quando realizada por radiologista treinado, ecografista ou ortopedista.
Os autores concluíram que, considerando acuidade, custo e segurança, a ecografia é a melhor opção.
abstract_excerpt: Diagnostic accuracy of US, MRI and MRA in the characterisation of full-thickness RC tears was high with overall estimates of sensitivity and specificity over 0.90. As for partial RC tears and tendinopathy, overall estimates of specificity were also high (>0.90), while sensitivity was lower (0.67-0.83). Diagnostic accuracy of US was similar whether a trained radiologist, sonographer or orthopaedist performed it. ... When considering accuracy, cost, and safety, US is the best option.

topic: Shoulder US: rotator cuff tears in surgical candidates (Cochrane DTA review)
title: Magnetic resonance imaging, magnetic resonance arthrography and ultrasonography for assessing rotator cuff tears in people with shoulder pain for whom surgery is being considered.
key_points: Cochrane diagnostic accuracy review of 20 studies (1147 shoulders) in people with suspected rotator cuff tears for whom surgery was being considered. Methodological quality was judged low or unclear.

Full-thickness tears: US summary sensitivity 92% (95% CI 82% to 96%) and specificity 93% (95% CI 81% to 97%) (10 studies, 729 shoulders). There was no statistically significant difference in diagnostic performance between MRI, MRA and US (P = 0.7), but the comparisons were mostly indirect.
Any rotator cuff tear: US summary sensitivity 91% (95% CI 83% to 95%) and specificity 85% (95% CI 74% to 92%) (13 studies, 854 shoulders).
Both MRI and US may have poor sensitivity for partial-thickness tears, and US sensitivity may be much lower than that of MRI.
key_points_pt: Revisão Cochrane de acuidade diagnóstica com 20 estudos (1147 ombros) em doentes com suspeita de rotura da coifa dos rotadores e candidatos a cirurgia. A qualidade metodológica foi considerada baixa ou incerta.

Roturas de espessura total: sensibilidade sumária da ecografia de 92% (IC 95% 82% a 96%) e especificidade de 93% (IC 95% 81% a 97%) (10 estudos, 729 ombros). Não houve diferença estatisticamente significativa no desempenho diagnóstico entre RM, artro-RM e ecografia (P = 0,7), mas as comparações foram sobretudo indiretas.
Qualquer rotura da coifa: sensibilidade sumária da ecografia de 91% (IC 95% 83% a 95%) e especificidade de 85% (IC 95% 74% a 92%) (13 estudos, 854 ombros).
Tanto a RM como a ecografia podem ter baixa sensibilidade para roturas de espessura parcial, e a sensibilidade da ecografia pode ser muito inferior à da RM.
abstract_excerpt: We included 20 studies of people with suspected rotator cuff tears (1147 shoulders), of which six evaluated MRI and US (252 shoulders), or MRA and US (127 shoulders) in the same people. ... Overall, the methodological quality of the studies was judged to be low or unclear. ... Similarly, for the comparison between MRI, MRA and US for detecting full thickness tears, there was no statistically significant difference in diagnostic performance (P = 0.7). For any rotator cuff tears, the summary sensitivity and specificity were 98% (95% CI 92% to 99%) and 79% (95% CI 68% to 87%) respectively for MRI (6 studies, 347 shoulders), and 91% (95% CI 83% to 95%) and 85% (95% CI 74% to 92%) respectively for US (13 studies, 854 shoulders). For full thickness tears, the summary sensitivity and specificity were 94% (95% CI 85% to 98%) and 93% (95% CI 83% to 97%) respectively for MRI (7 studies, 368 shoulders); 94% (95% CI 80% to 98%) and 92% (95% CI 83% to 97%) respectively for MRA (3 studies, 183 shoulders); and 92% (95% CI 82% to 96%) and 93% (95% CI 81% to 97%) respectively for US (10 studies, 729 shoulders). ... The test comparisons for each of the three classifications of the target condition were therefore based on indirect comparisons which may be prone to bias due to confounding. ... However, both MRI and US may have poor sensitivity for detecting partial thickness tears, and the sensitivity of US may be much lower than that of MRI.

topic: Shoulder US: dynamic assessment of subacromial impingement, cuff tears and long head of biceps vs surgery
title: Shoulder ultrasound: diagnostic accuracy for impingement syndrome, rotator cuff tear, and biceps tendon pathology.
journal: Journal of Shoulder and Elbow Surgery
key_points: In 42 consecutive surgical cases, US detected all 10 full-thickness cuff tears (sensitivity 1.0, specificity 0.97) but only 6 of 13 partial-thickness tears (sensitivity 0.46, specificity 0.97).
Dynamic scan criteria correctly diagnosed impingement in 27 of 34 cases (sensitivity 0.79, positive predictive value 0.96).
Dynamic US can help confirm, but not exclude, a clinical diagnosis of impingement.
Abnormalities of the long head of biceps were diagnosed accurately, except low-grade tendinitis and SLAP lesions.
key_points_pt: Em 42 casos cirúrgicos consecutivos, a ecografia detetou as 10 roturas de espessura total da coifa (sensibilidade 1,0; especificidade 0,97), mas apenas 6 de 13 roturas de espessura parcial (sensibilidade 0,46; especificidade 0,97).
Os critérios da avaliação dinâmica diagnosticaram corretamente o conflito subacromial em 27 de 34 casos (sensibilidade 0,79; valor preditivo positivo 0,96).
A ecografia dinâmica pode ajudar a confirmar, mas não a excluir, o diagnóstico clínico de conflito subacromial.
As alterações do tendão da longa porção do bicípite foram diagnosticadas com exatidão, exceto a tendinite de baixo grau e as lesões SLAP.
abstract_excerpt: The findings in 42 consecutive surgical cases were compared with the preoperative sonographic readings. Ultrasound detected all of the 10 full-thickness cuff tears identified at surgery (sensitivity 1.0, specificity 0.97) but detected only 6 of 13 partial-thickness cuff tears (sensitivity 0.46, specificity 0.97). ... Dynamic scan criteria correctly diagnosed impingement in 27 of 34 cases (sensitivity 0.79, positive predictive value 0.96). Abnormalities of the long head of the biceps were accurately diagnosed with the exception of low-grade tendinitis and the superior labral tear, anterior to posterior, lesion. ... Dynamic ultrasound can help confirm, but not exclude, a clinical diagnosis of impingement.

topic: Shoulder US: long head of biceps tendon pathology (instability, full and partial tears) vs clinical tests
title: Ultrasound is more reliable than clinical tests to both confirm and rule out pathologies of the long head of the biceps: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
key_points: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 7 studies (448 patients) comparing clinical tests or ultrasound against arthroscopy for long head of biceps tendon (LHBT) pathology.
LHBT instability (1 study): US sensitivity 1.00, specificity 0.96. Full-thickness tears (2 studies): US sensitivity 0.88-0.95, specificity 0.71-0.98.
Partial-thickness LHBT tears (4 studies): US sensitivity 0.27-0.71 and specificity 0.71-1.00, versus 0.17-0.68 and 0.38-0.92 for clinical tests.
The authors concluded that US is reliable both to confirm and to rule out LHBT pathology, whereas clinical tests are reliable only either to confirm or to rule it out.
key_points_pt: Revisão sistemática e meta-análise de 7 estudos (448 doentes) que comparou testes clínicos ou ecografia com a artroscopia na patologia do tendão da longa porção do bicípite (TLPB).
Instabilidade do TLPB (1 estudo): sensibilidade da ecografia de 1,00 e especificidade de 0,96. Roturas de espessura total (2 estudos): sensibilidade de 0,88-0,95 e especificidade de 0,71-0,98.
Roturas de espessura parcial do TLPB (4 estudos): sensibilidade da ecografia de 0,27-0,71 e especificidade de 0,71-1,00, contra 0,17-0,68 e 0,38-0,92 nos testes clínicos.

Os autores concluíram que a ecografia é fiável tanto para confirmar como para excluir patologia do TLPB, ao passo que os testes clínicos só são fiáveis para uma destas finalidades (confirmar ou excluir).
keywords: tendão da longa porção do bicípite
abstract_excerpt: Studies that compared the diagnostic accuracy of clinical tests or ultrasound versus arthroscopy for the assessment of LHBT pathologies were included. Seven studies were included reporting on a total of 448 patients. One study on instability using ultrasound reported sensitivity and specificity of 1.00 and 0.96, respectively. Two studies on full-thickness tears using ultrasound reported sensitivity and specificity of 0.88-0.95 and 0.71-0.98, respectively. Four studies on partial-thickness LHBT tears reported sensitivity and specificity of 0.17-0.68 and 0.38-0.92, respectively, for clinical tests, versus 0.27-0.71 and 0.71-1.00, respectively, for ultrasound. ... The clinical relevance of these findings is that clinical tests are only reliable either to confirm or rule out LHBT pathologies, whereas ultrasound is reliable both to confirm and rule out LHBT pathologies.

topic: Shoulder US: calcific tendinopathy features (size, fragmentation, power Doppler) and subacromial-subdeltoid bursa widening associated with pain
title: Assessment of calcific tendonitis of rotator cuff by ultrasonography: comparison between symptomatic and asymptomatic shoulders.
key_points: US with power Doppler was performed in 62 patients (81 shoulders) with symptomatic (n=57) or asymptomatic (n=24) rotator cuff calcific tendonitis.
Larger (p=0.0015) and fragmented (p=0.01) calcifications were associated with pain.

Power Doppler signal and subacromial-subdeltoid bursa widening were seen in 21 and 17 of the 57 symptomatic shoulders respectively, and in none of the asymptomatic shoulders (p<0.005). At least one of these signs was present in 31 of 57 (54%) symptomatic shoulders.
Power Doppler signal within the calcific deposit and SASD bursa widening were strongly associated with pain.
key_points_pt: Ecografia com power Doppler em 62 doentes (81 ombros) com tendinopatia calcificante da coifa dos rotadores, sintomática (n=57) ou assintomática (n=24).
Calcificações maiores (p=0,0015) e fragmentadas (p=0,01) associaram-se a dor.

Observaram-se sinal power Doppler e alargamento da bursa subacromiodeltoideia em 21 e 17 dos 57 ombros sintomáticos, respetivamente, e em nenhum dos ombros assintomáticos (p<0,005). Pelo menos um destes sinais estava presente em 31 de 57 (54%) ombros sintomáticos.
O sinal power Doppler no depósito cálcico e o alargamento da bursa subacromiodeltoideia associaram-se fortemente à dor.
abstract_excerpt: US was performed in 62 patients (81 shoulders) with symptomatic (n=57) or asymptomatic (n=24) calcific tendonitis. Calcific plaque morphology, power Doppler signaling, and widening of the subacromial-subdeltoid bursa (SSB) were recorded. ... Larger (p=0.0015) and fragmented (p=0.01) calcifications were associated with pain. A power Doppler signal and a widening of the SSB was identified in 21 and 17 of the 57 symptomatic calcification respectively, but in none of the cases of asymptomatic calcification (p<0,005). At least one of these signs was present in 31 of the 57 (54%) symptomatic shoulders (p<0.001). ... Positive power Doppler signal within the calcific deposit and SSB widening are US features strongly associated with pain.

topic: Tendinopathy US: Doppler neovascularisation in rotator cuff tendinopathy vs asymptomatic controls
title: Neovascularization prevalence in the supraspinatus of patients with rotator cuff tendinopathy.
key_points: Single-blind cross-sectional colour Doppler study of the supraspinatus tendon and subacromial bursae in 20 patients with rotator cuff tendinopathy (without full-thickness tears) and 20 age-, gender- and hand-dominance-matched asymptomatic controls.
Neovascularization was found in 6 of 20 patients (30%) and 5 of 20 controls (25%), with no statistically significant difference (P = 0.72).
The authors suggest neovascularization may not be a relevant sonographic finding for the clinical assessment of rotator cuff tendinopathy.
key_points_pt: Estudo transversal com ocultação simples, com Doppler a cores do tendão supraespinhoso e das bursas subacromiais, em 20 doentes com tendinopatia da coifa dos rotadores (sem roturas de espessura total) e 20 controlos assintomáticos emparelhados por idade, sexo e dominância manual.
Detetou-se neovascularização em 6 de 20 doentes (30%) e em 5 de 20 controlos (25%), sem diferença estatisticamente significativa (P = 0,72).
Os autores sugerem que a neovascularização pode não ser um achado ecográfico relevante para a avaliação clínica da tendinopatia da coifa dos rotadores.
abstract_excerpt: Participants (n = 40; age = 44.9 years, 23-62 years; 20 females) with rotator cuff tendinopathy (n = 20) but without full-thickness rotator cuff tears, and asymptomatic controls that were age, gender, and hand dominance matched (n = 20) to the patients. ... No statistically significant difference in neovascularization was identified between participants with and without rotator cuff tendinopathy (χ = 0.13, df = 1, P = 0.72). Neovascularization was identified in 6 of 20 patients with rotator cuff tendinopathy (30%) and 5 of 20 asymptomatic control participants (25%). ... Neovascularization may not be a relevant sonographic finding to aid the clinical assessment of those with rotator cuff tendinopathy.

topic: Tendinopathy US grading: parameters and scales (echogenicity, thickness, vascularity, calcification) for rotator cuff tendinopathy
title: The Use of Diagnostic Ultrasound for the Assessment of Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy: A Systematic Review.
key_points: Systematic review of 8 studies on the US parameters used to diagnose rotator cuff tendinopathy (studies with partial- or full-thickness tears excluded). There is currently no standardised US method.
The most common parameters were echogenicity (88%, n = 7), thickness (88%, n = 7), vascularity (50%, n = 4) and calcification (25%, n = 2).
A nominal scale was most commonly used for echogenicity (6 of 7 studies), thickness (5 of 7) and calcification (2 of 2). All studies that assessed vascularisation (100%) used an ordinal scale.
Patient positioning and operator experience varied between studies.
key_points_pt: Revisão sistemática de 8 estudos sobre os parâmetros ecográficos usados no diagnóstico da tendinopatia da coifa dos rotadores (excluídos os casos com roturas de espessura parcial ou total). Não existe atualmente um método ecográfico padronizado.
Os parâmetros mais frequentes foram a ecogenicidade (88%, n = 7), a espessura (88%, n = 7), a vascularização (50%, n = 4) e a calcificação (25%, n = 2).

A escala nominal foi a mais usada para a ecogenicidade (6 de 7 estudos), a espessura (5 de 7) e a calcificação (2 de 2). Todos os estudos que avaliaram a vascularização (100%) usaram uma escala ordinal.
O posicionamento do doente e a experiência do operador variaram entre estudos.
abstract_excerpt: However, there is currently no standardised method to assess RCT with US. ... Primary diagnosis of previous shoulder operations, partial or full-thickness tears, were excluded. ... A total of 1286 records were identified; eight studies met the inclusion criteria. ... The most common US parameters were echogenicity (88%, n = 7), thickness (88%, n = 7), vascularity (50%, n = 4) and calcification (25%, n = 2). A nominal grading scale was most commonly utilised when assessing echogenicity (86%, n = 6 of 7), thickness (71%, n = 5 of 7) and calcification (100%, n = 2 of 2), while an ordinal scale was utilised in 100% of studies assessing vascularisation. Additionally, it was noted positioning and operator experience varied between studies.

topic: Elbow US: lateral epicondylopathy, diagnostic validity of individual US features
title: The diagnostic validity of musculoskeletal ultrasound in lateral epicondylalgia: a systematic review.
key_points: Systematic review of 15 diagnostic studies of musculoskeletal ultrasound in lateral epicondylalgia, seven of them Level II diagnostic accuracy studies for chronic lateral epicondylalgia.
Hypoechogenicity of the common extensor origin had the best combination of sensitivity (0.64; 0.56-0.72) and specificity (0.82; 0.72-0.90).

Neovascularity (specificity 1.00), calcifications (specificity 0.97) and cortical irregularities (specificity 0.96) were strongly specific for chronic lateral epicondylalgia. Bone changes on the lateral epicondyle had a sensitivity of 0.56.
Evidence was insufficient for power Doppler, real-time sonoelastography and sonographic probe-induced tenderness. Grey-scale US is recommended.
key_points_pt: Revisão sistemática de 15 estudos diagnósticos sobre ecografia musculoesquelética na epicondilalgia lateral, sete dos quais estudos de acuidade diagnóstica de nível II na epicondilalgia lateral crónica.
A hipoecogenicidade da origem comum dos extensores teve a melhor combinação de sensibilidade (0,64; 0,56-0,72) e especificidade (0,82; 0,72-0,90).

A neovascularização (especificidade 1,00), as calcificações (especificidade 0,97) e as irregularidades corticais (especificidade 0,96) foram muito específicas para a epicondilalgia lateral crónica. As alterações ósseas do epicôndilo lateral tiveram sensibilidade de 0,56.
A evidência foi insuficiente para o power Doppler, a sonoelastografia em tempo real e a dor provocada pela sonda. Recomenda-se a ecografia em escala de cinzentos.
abstract_excerpt: Among the 15 included diagnostic studies in this review, seven were Level II diagnostic accuracy studies for chronic lateral epicondylalgia based on the National Health and Medical Research Council Hierarchy of Evidence. Based from the pooled sensitivity of abnormal ultrasound findings with homogenous results (p > 0.05), the hypoechogenicity of the common extensor origin has the best combination of diagnostic sensitivity and specificity. It is moderately sensitive [Sensitivity: 0.64 (0.56-0.72)] and highly specific [Specificity: 0.82 (0.72-0.90)] in determining elbows with lateral epicondylalgia. Additionally, bone changes on the lateral epicondyle [Sensitivity: 0.56 (0.50-0.62)] were moderately sensitive to chronic LE. Conversely, neovascularity [Specificity: 1.00 (0.97-1.00)], calcifications [Specificity: 0.97 (0.94-0.99)] and cortical irregularities [Specificity: 0.96 (0.88-0.99)] have strong specificity for chronic lateral epicondylalgia. There is insufficient evidence supporting the use of Power Doppler Ultrasonogrophy, Real-time Sonoelastography and sonographic probe-induced tenderness in diagnosing LE. The use of Gray-scale Ultrasonography is recommended in objectively diagnosing lateral epicondylalgia.

topic: Elbow US: ulnar nerve cross-sectional area cut-off for cubital tunnel syndrome
title: Ulnar Nerve Cross-Sectional Area for the Diagnosis of Cubital Tunnel Syndrome: A Meta-Analysis of Ultrasonographic Measurements.
journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
key_points: Meta-analysis of 14 trials comparing ulnar nerve cross-sectional area (CSA) in participants with and without cubital tunnel syndrome (CuTS).

The between-group CSA difference was largest at the medial epicondyle (6.0 mm2; 95% CI 4.5-7.4 mm2). In participants without CuTS, pooled mean CSA was 6.6 mm2 at the medial epicondyle, 7.4 mm2 at the cubital tunnel inlet and 7.3 mm2 at the outlet.
With a 10 mm2 cutoff (5 studies): sensitivity .85 (95% CI .78-.90), specificity .91 (95% CI .86-.94), diagnostic odds ratio 53.96 (95% CI 14.84-196.14).
Because ulnar nerve CSA in healthy participants rarely exceeds 10 mm2, the authors propose this value as a cutoff for ulnar nerve entrapment at the elbow.
key_points_pt: Meta-análise de 14 estudos que compararam a área de secção transversal (AST) do nervo cubital entre participantes com e sem síndrome do túnel cubital.

A diferença de AST entre grupos foi máxima ao nível do epicôndilo medial (6,0 mm²; IC 95% 4,5-7,4 mm²). Nos participantes sem síndrome, a AST média agregada foi de 6,6 mm² no epicôndilo medial, 7,4 mm² na entrada e 7,3 mm² na saída do túnel cubital.
Com ponto de corte de 10 mm² (5 estudos): sensibilidade de 0,85 (IC 95% 0,78-0,90), especificidade de 0,91 (IC 95% 0,86-0,94) e odds ratio diagnóstico de 53,96 (IC 95% 14,84-196,14).
Como a AST do nervo cubital em indivíduos saudáveis raramente excede 10 mm², os autores propõem este valor como ponto de corte para neuropatia compressiva do nervo cubital no cotovelo.
abstract_excerpt: Fourteen trials comparing the ulnar nerve CSA measurements between participants with and without CuTS were included. ... Among different elbow levels, the between-group difference in CSA was the largest at the medial epicondyle (6.0mm2; 95% confidence interval [CI], 4.5-7.4mm2). The pooled mean CSA in participants without CuTS was 5.5mm2 (95% CI, 4.4-6.6mm2) at the arm level, 7.4mm2 (95% CI, 6.7-8.1mm2) at the cubital tunnel inlet, 6.6mm2 (95% CI, 5.9-7.2mm2) at the medial epicondyle, 7.3mm2 (95% CI, 5.6-9.0mm2) at the cubital tunnel outlet, and 5.5mm2 (95% CI, 4.7-6.3mm2) at the forearm level. The sensitivities, specificities, and diagnostic odds ratios pooled from 5 studies, using 10mm2 as the cutoff point, were .85 (95% CI, .78-.90), .91 (95% CI, .86-.94), and 53.96 (95% CI, 14.84-196.14), respectively. ... Because the ulnar nerve CSA in healthy participants, at various locations, rarely exceeds 10mm2, this value can be considered as a cutoff point for diagnosing ulnar nerve entrapment at the elbow region.

topic: Wrist US: carpal tunnel syndrome, median nerve CSA cut-off (meta-analysis)
title: Ultrasonography for diagnosing carpal tunnel syndrome: a meta-analysis of diagnostic test accuracy.
key_points: Meta-analysis of 28 trials (3995 wrists) of ultrasonography for carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS), based on PubMed searches for 1990-2010.
Wrists with CTS had a greater median nerve CSA at the carpal tunnel inlet and a greater flattening ratio at the level of the hamate than control wrists.
A CSA at the inlet of 9 mm2 or more was the best single criterion: diagnostic odds ratio 40.4, sensitivity 87.3%, specificity 83.3%.
key_points_pt: Meta-análise de 28 estudos (3995 punhos) sobre ecografia na síndrome do túnel cárpico, baseada em pesquisas na PubMed de 1990 a 2010.

Os punhos com síndrome do túnel cárpico tinham maior área de secção transversal (AST) do nervo mediano na entrada do túnel cárpico e maior índice de achatamento ao nível do hamato do que os punhos controlo.
Uma AST na entrada igual ou superior a 9 mm² foi o melhor critério isolado: odds ratio diagnóstico de 40,4, sensibilidade de 87,3% e especificidade de 83,3%.
abstract_excerpt: Structured searches of PubMed for 1990-2010 were done and the data were extracted and meta-analyzed by pooling estimates of sensitivity, specificity, likelihood ratios and diagnostic odds ratios. ... Twenty-eight trials involving 3995 wrists were included. A greater cross-sectional area (CSA) of the median nerve at the carpal tunnel inlet (CSA-I) and a greater flattening ratio at the level of the hamate were seen in CTS wrists than in control wrists. A CSA-I ≥9 mm(2) is the best single diagnostic criterion, with a diagnostic odds ratio of 40.4 (sensitivity 87.3%, specificity 83.3%).

topic: Wrist US: evidence-based guideline on neuromuscular ultrasound for carpal tunnel syndrome
title: Evidence-based guideline: neuromuscular ultrasound for the diagnosis of carpal tunnel syndrome.
key_points: Evidence-based guideline built on a systematic review, with studies classified by American Academy of Neurology criteria: US measurement of median nerve CSA at the wrist is accurate and may be offered as a diagnostic test for carpal tunnel syndrome (Level A).
Neuromuscular US probably adds value to electrodiagnostic studies when diagnosing CTS and should be considered when screening for structural abnormalities at the wrist (Level B).
key_points_pt: Recomendação baseada na evidência, construída sobre uma revisão sistemática com classificação dos estudos segundo os critérios da American Academy of Neurology: a medição ecográfica da área de secção transversal do nervo mediano no punho é exata e pode ser oferecida como teste diagnóstico da síndrome do túnel cárpico (Nível A).

A ecografia neuromuscular provavelmente acrescenta valor aos estudos eletrodiagnósticos no diagnóstico da síndrome do túnel cárpico e deve ser considerada para pesquisar alterações estruturais no punho (Nível B).
keywords: área de secção transversal do nervo mediano
abstract_excerpt: A systematic review was performed, and studies were classified according to American Academy of Neurology criteria for rating articles of diagnostic accuracy (question 1) and for screening articles (question 2). Neuromuscular ultrasound measurement of median nerve cross-sectional area at the wrist is accurate and may be offered as a diagnostic test for CTS (Level A). Neuromuscular ultrasound probably adds value to electrodiagnostic studies when diagnosing CTS and should be considered in screening for structural abnormalities at the wrist in those with CTS (Level B).

topic: Wrist US: median nerve CSA by electrodiagnostic severity of carpal tunnel syndrome
title: Ultrasonographic Assessment of Carpal Tunnel Syndrome Severity: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
journal: American Journal of Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation
key_points: Meta-analysis of 16 studies (2292 wrists: 776 mild, 823 moderate, 693 severe CTS by electrodiagnostic classification) of median nerve CSA measured at the carpal tunnel inlet.

Pooled mean CSA was 11.64 (95% CI 11.23-12.05) in mild, 13.74 (95% CI 12.59-14.89) in moderate and 16.80 (95% CI 14.50-19.1) in severe CTS. The abstract prints the unit as 'mm'; the quantity is an area (mm2).
key_points_pt: Meta-análise de 16 estudos (2292 punhos: 776 ligeiros, 823 moderados e 693 graves segundo a classificação eletrodiagnóstica) da área de secção transversal do nervo mediano medida na entrada do túnel cárpico.

A AST média agregada foi de 11,64 (IC 95% 11,23-12,05) na síndrome ligeira, 13,74 (IC 95% 12,59-14,89) na moderada e 16,80 (IC 95% 14,50-19,1) na grave. O resumo apresenta a unidade como 'mm'; trata-se de uma área (mm²).
keywords: gravidade da síndrome do túnel cárpico
área de secção transversal do nervo mediano
abstract_excerpt: Cross-sectional area values measured at the carpal tunnel inlet were included in the analyses. ... Finally, 16 articles were included for meta-analysis. These studies included a total sample of 2292 wrists including 776 mild, 823 moderate, and 693 severe carpal tunnel syndrome. The pooled analysis revealed a mean cross-sectional area of 11.64 mm (95% confidence interval = 11.23-12.05 mm, P < 0.001) for mild carpal tunnel syndrome, a mean cross-sectional area of 13.74 mm (95% confidence interval = 12.59-14.89 mm, P < 0.001) for moderate carpal tunnel syndrome, and a mean cross-sectional area of 16.80 mm (95% confidence interval = 14.50-19.1 mm, P < 0.001) for severe carpal tunnel syndrome.

topic: Wrist US: De Quervain tenosynovitis, detection of the first extensor compartment intracompartmental septum
title: Sonographic Identification of the intracompartmental septum in de Quervain's disease.
key_points: 43 wrists (40 patients) unresponsive to nonoperative treatment underwent surgical release for de Quervain's disease. Preoperative sonography by a radiologist was compared with surgical findings (Level I diagnostic study).

Sonography identified the intracompartmental septum in 19 of 19 wrists that had one and correctly showed its absence in 23 of 24: sensitivity 100% (95% CI 80%-100%), specificity 96% (95% CI 78%-100%), accuracy 98%.
Septum-like structures were also seen in 15 of 37 (41%) asymptomatic contralateral wrists.
key_points_pt: 43 punhos (40 doentes) sem resposta ao tratamento conservador foram submetidos a libertação cirúrgica por tenossinovite de De Quervain. A ecografia pré-operatória, realizada por radiologista, foi comparada com os achados cirúrgicos (estudo diagnóstico de nível I).

A ecografia identificou o septo intracompartimental em 19 de 19 punhos com septo e mostrou corretamente a sua ausência em 23 de 24: sensibilidade de 100% (IC 95% 80%-100%), especificidade de 96% (IC 95% 78%-100%) e exatidão de 98%.
Também se observaram estruturas semelhantes a septo em 15 de 37 (41%) punhos contralaterais assintomáticos.
abstract_excerpt: We performed surgical release of the first extensor compartment in 43 wrists of 40 patients who were unresponsive to nonoperative treatment. In each case, a sonographic evaluation was performed before surgery by a radiologist and the sonographic and surgical findings were compared. Sonography identified the intracompartmental septum in 19 of the 19 septum-present wrists and absence of the septum in 23 of the 24 septum-absent wrists. The sensitivity of sonography was 100% (95% confidence interval, 80%-100%), its specificity 96% (95% confidence interval, 78%-100%), accuracy 98% (95% confidence interval, 87%-100%), positive predictive value 95% (95% confidence interval, 74%-100%), and negative predictive value 100% (95% confidence interval, 83%-100%). Sonography also identified septum-like structures in 15 of 37 (41%) asymptomatic contralateral wrists.

topic: Hand US: trigger finger, A1 pulley thickness and power Doppler
title: Sonographic appearance of trigger fingers.
key_points: 33 trigger fingers (33 patients) were compared with 20 controls using a 7- to 15-MHz probe, with measurement of A1 pulley thickness and power Doppler assessment.
All trigger fingers showed a thickened, hypoechoic A1 pulley. Mean A1 pulley thickness was 1.8 mm (range 1.1-2.9) in trigger fingers versus 0.5 mm (range 0.4-0.6) in controls (P < .0001).
Power Doppler showed A1 pulley hypervascularization in 91% of trigger fingers and in none of the controls. Flexor tendinosis was present in 48% and tenosynovitis in 55%.
key_points_pt: 33 dedos em gatilho (33 doentes) foram comparados com 20 controlos com sonda de 7 a 15 MHz, com medição da espessura da polia A1 e avaliação com power Doppler.

Todos os dedos em gatilho tinham a polia A1 espessada e hipoecogénica. A espessura média da polia A1 foi de 1,8 mm (intervalo 1,1-2,9) nos dedos em gatilho e de 0,5 mm (intervalo 0,4-0,6) nos controlos (P < 0,0001).
O power Doppler mostrou hipervascularização da polia A1 em 91% dos dedos em gatilho e em nenhum controlo. Havia tendinose dos flexores em 48% e tenossinovite em 55%.
abstract_excerpt: Thirty-three trigger fingers in 33 patients were examined with a 7- to 15-MHz probe. A control group consisted of 20 patients without trigger fingers. ... Thickening and hypoechogenicity of the A1 pulley were found in all patients with trigger fingers. Measurements of A1 pulley thickness were significantly different (P < .0001) between the groups without trigger fingers (mean, 0.5 mm; range, 0.4-0.6 mm) and with trigger fingers (mean, 1.8 mm; range, 1.1-2.9 mm). Hypervascularization of the A1 pulley on power Doppler imaging was found in 91% of the trigger fingers but was never found in the healthy control group. Flexor tendinosis was found in 48% of the trigger fingers; tenosynovitis was found in 55%; and both were found in 39%.

topic: Wrist/hand US: sonographic appearance of ganglion cysts (simple, complex, solid-appearing)
title: Ganglia of the hand and wrist: a sonographic analysis.
key_points: Retrospective sonographic analysis (reports and images found by computer search) of 60 pathologically proven hand and wrist ganglia: 34 complex, 23 simple and 3 solid-appearing.

Of the 34 complex ganglia, 91% were in the dorsal or volar wrist; the abstract reports well-defined margins in 97%, locules in 76%, acoustic enhancement in 68%, a thick wall in 47%, internal reflectors in 15% and blood flow in 12%.
A visible neck was seen in 25% of ganglia. Most flexor tendon sheath ganglia were simple.
Solid-appearing ganglia are unusual but may mimic a benign neoplasm or synovitis.
key_points_pt: Análise ecográfica retrospetiva (relatórios e imagens obtidos por pesquisa informática) de 60 gânglios (quistos sinoviais) da mão e do punho com confirmação anatomopatológica: 34 complexos, 23 simples e 3 de aspeto sólido.

Dos 34 gânglios complexos, 91% localizavam-se no punho dorsal ou volar; o resumo refere margens bem definidas em 97%, loculações em 76%, reforço acústico posterior em 68%, parede espessa em 47%, ecos internos em 15% e fluxo sanguíneo em 12%.
Foi visível um colo (pedículo) em 25% dos gânglios. A maioria dos gânglios da bainha dos tendões flexores era simples.
Os gânglios de aspeto sólido são raros, mas podem simular neoplasia benigna ou sinovite.
abstract_excerpt: The purpose of this study was to analyze the sonographic appearance of a large series of pathologically proven ganglia. A computer search of sonography and pathology reports for hand and wrist ganglia was performed. ... Of 60 ganglia, 34 were complex, 91% of which were located within the dorsal or volar wrist; 97% had well-defined margins; 76%, locules; 68%, acoustic enhancement; 47%, a thick wall; 15%, internal reflectors; and 12%, blood flow. Of the 23 simple ganglia, 11 involved the extensor or flexor tendon sheath, 73% of which were simple. ... Three ganglia were solid-appearing. A visible neck was seen in 25% of ganglia. ... Most flexor tendon sheath ganglia are simple rather than complex. Solid-appearing ganglia, although unusual, may mimic a benign neoplasm or synovitis.

topic: Standards: ESSR Delphi consensus on clinical indications for musculoskeletal ultrasound (2017 update)
title: Clinical indications for musculoskeletal ultrasound updated in 2017 by European Society of Musculoskeletal Radiology (ESSR) consensus.
key_points: ESSR Delphi consensus of 21 musculoskeletal imaging experts updating the 2012 ESSR clinical guidelines for musculoskeletal ultrasound referral. Literature up to July 2017 was scored for the shoulder, elbow, wrist/hand, hip, knee and ankle/foot.
123 new papers were reviewed. There was no change in evidence for the shoulder (no new relevant articles); 10 new articles were reviewed for the elbow and 28 for the hand/wrist.
Elastography did not reach level A evidence. For Achilles tendinopathy and lateral epicondylitis, the evidence level was B with a grade 3 indication.
Four new level A indications were added: gluteal tendon tears, meniscal cysts, ankle joint instability and plantar plate tear.
key_points_pt: Consenso Delphi da ESSR com 21 peritos em imagiologia musculoesquelética, que atualiza as recomendações clínicas da ESSR de 2012 para referenciação para ecografia musculoesquelética. A literatura até julho de 2017 foi pontuada para ombro, cotovelo, punho/mão, anca, joelho e tornozelo/pé.
Foram revistos 123 novos artigos. Não houve alteração da evidência para o ombro (sem novos artigos relevantes); foram revistos 10 novos artigos para o cotovelo e 28 para a mão/punho.
A elastografia não atingiu o nível de evidência A. Na tendinopatia aquiliana e na epicondilite lateral, o nível de evidência foi B, com indicação de grau 3.
Foram acrescentadas quatro novas indicações de nível A: roturas dos tendões glúteos, quistos meniscais, instabilidade da articulação do tornozelo e rotura da placa plantar.
abstract_excerpt: To update the 2012 European Society of Musculoskeletal Radiology (ESSR) clinical consensus guidelines for musculoskeletal ultrasound referral in Europe. Twenty-one musculoskeletal imaging experts from the ESSR participated in a consensus study based on a Delphic process. ... Updated musculoskeletal ultrasound literature up to July 2017 was scored for shoulder, elbow, wrist/hand, hip, knee, and ankle/foot. ... A total of 123 new papers were reviewed. No evidence change was found regarding the shoulder. There were no new relevant articles for the shoulder, 10 new articles for the elbow, 28 for the hand/wrist, 3 for the hip, 7 for the knee, and 4 for the ankle/foot. Four new evidence levels of A were determined, one for the hip (gluteal tendons tears), one for the knee (meniscal cysts), one for the ankle (ankle joint instability), and one for the foot (plantar plate tear). There was no level A evidence for elastography, although for Achilles tendinopathy and lateral epicondylitis evidence level was B with grade 3 indication.

topic: Standards: EULAR 2017 standardised scanning procedures for musculoskeletal ultrasound
title: The 2017 EULAR standardised procedures for ultrasound imaging in rheumatology.
key_points: EULAR update of the 2001 musculoskeletal ultrasound guidelines in rheumatology, built from a systematic literature review, a Delphi survey of rheumatologist and radiologist experts and a nominal group technique.

Standardised scanning procedures (patient position, probe placement, scanning method and bony/other landmarks) were defined for structures in nine areas: shoulder, elbow, wrist and hand, hip, knee, ankle and foot, peripheral nerves, salivary glands and vessels. They were compiled in an illustrated App.
Experts agreed which abnormalities US can evaluate in each anatomical structure and how relevant they are for rheumatology.
key_points_pt: Atualização EULAR das recomendações de 2001 para ecografia musculoesquelética em reumatologia, construída com revisão sistemática da literatura, inquérito Delphi a peritos reumatologistas e radiologistas e técnica de grupo nominal.

Foram definidos procedimentos padronizados de exploração (posição do doente, colocação da sonda, método de varrimento e referências ósseas/outras) para estruturas de nove áreas: ombro, cotovelo, punho e mão, anca, joelho, tornozelo e pé, nervos periféricos, glândulas salivares e vasos. Os procedimentos foram reunidos numa aplicação ilustrada.
Os peritos acordaram que alterações a ecografia pode avaliar em cada estrutura anatómica e qual a sua relevância em reumatologia.
abstract_excerpt: In 2001, the European League Against Rheumatism developed and disseminated the first guidelines for musculoskeletal (MS) ultrasound (US) in rheumatology. ... The project consisted of the following steps: (1) a systematic literature review of MSUS evaluable structures; (2) a Delphi survey among rheumatologist and radiologist experts in MSUS to select MS and non-MS anatomic structures evaluable by US that are relevant to rheumatology, to select abnormalities evaluable by US and to prioritise these pathologies for rheumatology and (3) a nominal group technique to achieve consensus on the US scanning procedures and to produce an electronic illustrated manual (ie, App of these procedures). Structures from nine MS and non-MS areas (ie, shoulder, elbow, wrist and hand, hip, knee, ankle and foot, peripheral nerves, salivary glands and vessels) were selected for MSUS in rheumatic and musculoskeletal diseases (RMD) and their detailed scanning procedures (ie, patient position, probe placement, scanning method and bony/other landmarks) were used to produce the App. In addition, US evaluable abnormalities present in RMD for each anatomic structure and their relevance for rheumatology were agreed on by the MSUS experts.

topic: Standards: OMERACT US definition and scoring of enthesitis
title: Reliability of a consensus-based ultrasound definition and scoring for enthesitis in spondyloarthritis and psoriatic arthritis: an OMERACT US initiative.
key_points: In this OMERACT US initiative, 11 sonographers evaluated 40 entheses from 5 SpA/PsA patients at four bilateral sites and gave a binary score for each of nine elementary lesions.
The final US definition of enthesitis includes hypoechogenicity, increased thickness at the enthesis, erosions, calcifications/enthesophytes and Doppler signal at the insertion.

Reliability ranged from poor (thickened enthesis, kappa 0.1) to good (enthesophytes, kappa 0.6). After adjustment for low prevalence, kappa was 0.9 for Doppler signal at the insertion and 0.8 for bursitis.
key_points_pt: Nesta iniciativa de ecografia do OMERACT, 11 ecografistas avaliaram 40 enteses de 5 doentes com espondilartrite ou artrite psoriática, em quatro locais bilaterais, e pontuaram de forma binária cada uma de nove lesões elementares.
A definição ecográfica final de entesite inclui hipoecogenicidade, aumento da espessura da entese, erosões, calcificações/entesófitos e sinal Doppler na inserção.

A fiabilidade variou de fraca (entese espessada, kappa 0,1) a boa (entesófitos, kappa 0,6). Após ajuste para a baixa prevalência, o kappa foi de 0,9 para o sinal Doppler na inserção e de 0,8 para a bursite.
abstract_excerpt: Eleven sonographers evaluated 40 entheses from five patients with SpA/PsA at four bilateral sites. Nine US elementary lesions were binary-scored: hypoechogenicity, thickened insertion, enthesophytes, calcifications, erosions, bone irregularities, bursitis and Doppler signal inside and around enthesis. ... Reliability ranged from poor to good (the lowest for thickened enthesis (kappa 0.1 (95% CI 0 to 0.7)) and the highest for enthesophytes (kappa 0.6 (95% CI 0.5 to 0.7)). When adjusted for low prevalence, kappa values increased for all lesions, with the best result observed for detecting Doppler signal at insertion (0.9) and for bursitis (0.8). The US components included in the final definition were hypoechogenicity, increased thickness at enthesis, erosions and calcifications/enthesophytes and Doppler signal at insertion.

topic: Standards: EULAR-OMERACT US definition and semiquantitative scoring of synovitis (grey-scale + power Doppler)
title: Scoring ultrasound synovitis in rheumatoid arthritis: a EULAR-OMERACT ultrasound taskforce-Part 1: definition and development of a standardised, consensus-based scoring system.
key_points: A multistep EULAR-OMERACT consensus process, including a Delphi exercise, produced a standardised US definition and semiquantitative scoring system for RA synovitis.

The refined OMERACT synovitis definition includes the presence of both hypoechoic synovial hypertrophy and power Doppler signal. The semiquantitative severity score depends on the amount of PD signal and on the volume and appearance of the synovial hypertrophy.

On static images, intra- and inter-reader reliability for PD scoring was excellent for both binary and semiquantitative grading, while grey-scale scoring was more variable. In patient-based exercises, mean kappa did not reach 0.50 for any component.
key_points_pt: Um processo de consenso EULAR-OMERACT em várias etapas, incluindo um exercício Delphi, produziu uma definição ecográfica padronizada e um sistema de pontuação semiquantitativo da sinovite na artrite reumatoide.

A definição OMERACT refinada de sinovite inclui a presença de hipertrofia sinovial hipoecogénica e de sinal power Doppler. A pontuação semiquantitativa de gravidade depende da quantidade de sinal Doppler e do volume e aspeto da hipertrofia sinovial.

Em imagens estáticas, a fiabilidade intra e interobservador da pontuação Doppler foi excelente, tanto na graduação binária como na semiquantitativa, e a escala de cinzentos foi mais variável. Nos exercícios com doentes, o kappa médio não atingiu 0,50 em nenhum componente.
abstract_excerpt: Using static images, intrareader and inter-reader reliability for scoring PD were excellent for both binary and semiquantitative (SQ) grading but GS showed greater variability for both scoring systems (κ ranges: -0.05 to 1 and 0.59 to 0.92, respectively). In patient-based exercise, both intraobserver and interobserver reliability were variable and the mean κ coefficients did not reach 0.50 for any of the components. The second step resulted in refinement of the preliminary Outcome Measures in Rheumatology synovitis definition by including the presence of both hypoechoic SH and PD signal and the development of a SQ severity score, depending on both the amount of PD and the volume and appearance of SH. A multistep consensus-based process has produced a standardised US definition and quantification system for RA synovitis including combined and individual SH and PD components.

topic: Muscle injury classification: British Athletics Muscle Injury Classification (BAMIC)
title: British athletics muscle injury classification: a new grading system.
key_points: BAMIC grades muscle injuries 0-4 based on MRI features.
Grades 1-4 include an additional suffix 'a', 'b' or 'c' if the injury is myofascial, musculo-tendinous or intratendinous, respectively.
The commonly used three-grade systems (minor, moderate, complete) are described as lacking diagnostic accuracy and providing limited prognostic information.
At publication, retrospective and prospective studies in elite track and field athletes were underway to validate the classification for hamstring muscle injury management.
key_points_pt: A BAMIC gradua as lesões musculares de 0 a 4 com base em características de ressonância magnética (RM).
Os graus 1-4 incluem um sufixo adicional 'a', 'b' ou 'c' consoante a lesão seja miofascial, musculotendinosa ou intratendinosa, respetivamente.

Os sistemas de graduação habitualmente utilizados, com três graus (lesão ligeira, moderada e completa), são descritos como pouco exatos do ponto de vista diagnóstico e com informação prognóstica limitada.
À data da publicação, decorriam estudos retrospetivos e prospetivos em atletas de elite de atletismo para validar a classificação na abordagem das lesões musculares dos isquiotibiais.
abstract_excerpt: The commonly used muscle injury grading systems based on three grades of injury, representing minor, moderate and complete injuries to the muscle, are lacking in diagnostic accuracy and provide limited prognostic information to the clinician. [...] Injuries are graded 0-4 based on MRI features, with Grades 1-4 including an additional suffix 'a', 'b' or 'c' if the injury is 'myofascial', 'musculo-tendinous' or 'intratendinous'. Retrospective and prospective studies in elite track and field athletes are underway to validate the classification for use in hamstring muscle injury management.

topic: Muscle injury terminology and classification: Munich consensus statement
title: Terminology and classification of muscle injuries in sport: the Munich consensus statement.
key_points: Four types are defined: functional muscle disorders without macroscopic evidence of fibre tear (type 1 overexertion-related; type 2 neuromuscular) and structural muscle injuries with macroscopic evidence of fibre tear (type 3 partial tears; type 4 (sub)total tears/tendinous avulsions).
Subclassifications are presented for each type.

A questionnaire of 30 native English-speaking scientists and team doctors (response rate 63%) confirmed marked variability in muscle-injury terminology, with the most obvious inconsistencies for the term 'strain'.
Level of evidence: expert opinion, Level V.
key_points_pt: Definem-se quatro tipos: perturbações musculares funcionais sem evidência macroscópica de rotura de fibras (tipo 1 relacionadas com sobrecarga; tipo 2 neuromusculares) e lesões musculares estruturais com evidência macroscópica de rotura de fibras (tipo 3 roturas parciais; tipo 4 roturas (sub)totais/avulsões tendinosas).
São apresentadas subclassificações para cada tipo.

Um questionário a 30 cientistas e médicos de equipa nativos de língua inglesa (taxa de resposta de 63%) confirmou grande variabilidade na terminologia das lesões musculares, com as inconsistências mais evidentes no termo 'strain' (distensão).
Nível de evidência: opinião de peritos, nível V.
abstract_excerpt: RESULTS: The response rate of the survey was 63%. The responses confirmed the marked variability in the use of the terminology relating to muscle injury, with the most obvious inconsistencies for the term strain. In the consensus meeting, practical and systematic terms were defined and established. In addition, a new comprehensive classification system was developed, which differentiates between four types: functional muscle disorders (type 1: overexertion-related and type 2: neuromuscular muscle disorders) describing disorders without macroscopic evidence of fibre tear and structural muscle injuries (type 3: partial tears and type 4: (sub)total tears/tendinous avulsions) with macroscopic evidence of fibre tear, that is, structural damage. Subclassifications are presented for each type. [...] LEVEL OF EVIDENCE: Expert opinion, Level V.

topic: Hamstring injury prognosis: BAMIC intratendinous ('c') injuries and return to training
title: Time to return to full training is delayed and recurrence rate is higher in intratendinous ('c') acute hamstring injury in elite track and field athletes: clinical application of the British Athletics Muscle Injury Classification.
key_points: Retrospective cohort: 65 acute hamstring injuries in 44 elite track and field athletes, with MRI within 7 days of injury graded by two musculoskeletal radiologists using BAMIC.
Time to return to full training differed among grades (p<0.001): grade 3 and intratendinous ('c') injuries took significantly longer, grade 0 injuries less.
There were 12 re-injuries; recurrence was significantly higher in intratendinous ('c') injuries (p<0.001).
No difference in re-injury rate between grades 1-3, hamstring muscle affected, location (proximal vs central vs distal), age or sex.
key_points_pt: Coorte retrospetiva: 65 lesões agudas dos isquiotibiais em 44 atletas de elite de atletismo, com RM até 7 dias após a lesão, graduada por dois radiologistas musculoesqueléticos segundo a BAMIC.
O tempo até ao regresso ao treino completo diferiu entre graus (p<0,001): as lesões de grau 3 e as intratendinosas ('c') demoraram significativamente mais, e as de grau 0 menos.
Registaram-se 12 recidivas; a taxa de recidiva foi significativamente superior nas lesões intratendinosas ('c') (p<0,001).
Não houve diferença na taxa de recidiva entre os graus 1-3, músculo isquiotibial afetado, localização (proximal vs central vs distal), idade ou sexo.
abstract_excerpt: Athletes who sustained an acute hamstring injury, with MRI investigation within 7 days of injury, were included. MRI were graded by two musculoskeletal radiologists using the British Athletics Muscle Injury Classification. [...] RESULTS: There were 65 hamstring injuries in 44 athletes (24±4.4 years; 28 male, 16 female). TRFT differed among grades (p<0.001). Grade 3 injuries and 'c' injuries took significantly longer and grade 0 injuries took less TRFT. There were 12 re-injuries; the injury recurrence rate was significantly higher in intratendinous (c) injuries (p<0.001). There was no difference in re-injury rate between number grades 1-3, hamstring muscle affected, location (proximal vs central vs distal), age or sex.

topic: Hamstring injury: prognostic value of MRI for return to play (systematic review)
title: Magnetic resonance imaging in acute hamstring injury: can we provide a return to play prognosis?
key_points: Of 12 included studies, one had a low and 11 a high risk of bias.
Moderate evidence: injuries without hyperintensity on fluid-sensitive sequences are associated with shorter time to return to play (RTP); injuries involving the proximal free tendon with longer RTP.
Limited evidence: central tendon disruption, injury not affecting the musculotendinous junction and total rupture are associated with longer RTP.
There is currently no strong evidence for any MRI finding that gives a prognosis on time to RTP after acute hamstring injury, owing to considerable risks of bias in the studies.
key_points_pt: Dos 12 estudos incluídos, um tinha baixo risco de viés e 11 alto risco de viés.

Evidência moderada: lesões sem hiperintensidade nas sequências sensíveis a líquido associam-se a menor tempo até ao regresso à competição (RTP); lesões envolvendo o tendão livre proximal associam-se a RTP mais longo.
Evidência limitada: rotura do tendão central, lesão que não envolve a junção musculotendinosa e rotura total associam-se a RTP mais longo.
Atualmente não há evidência forte de que algum achado de RM permita prever o tempo até ao RTP após lesão aguda dos isquiotibiais, devido ao considerável risco de viés dos estudos.
keywords: hiperintensidade em sequências sensíveis a líquido
abstract_excerpt: RESULTS: Of the 12 studies included, one had a low risk of bias and 11 a high risk of bias. There is moderate evidence that injuries without hyperintensity on fluid-sensitive sequences are associated with a shorter time to RTP and that injuries involving the proximal free tendon are associated with a longer time to RTP. Limited evidence was found for an association of central tendon disruption, injury not affecting the musculotendinous junction and a total rupture with a longer time to RTP. The other MRI findings studied showed either no association or there was conflicting evidence. CONCLUSION: There is currently no strong evidence for any MRI finding that gives a prognosis on the time to RTP after an acute hamstring injury, owing to considerable risks of bias in the studies on this topic.

topic: Hamstring injury: MRI grade, oedema size and return to play in elite football (prospective cohort)
title: MRI findings and return to play in football: a prospective analysis of 255 hamstring injuries in the UEFA Elite Club Injury Study.
key_points: Prospective analysis of 255 grade 1 and 2 hamstring injuries in male professional footballers (46 elite European teams, 2007-2014), MRI evaluated by two independent radiologists.
RTP was longer for grade 2 than grade 1 injuries (24±13 vs 18±15 days; mean difference 6 days, 95% CI 2 to 9, p=0.004).

84% of injuries affected the biceps femoris; lay-off time did not differ between the three muscles (p=0.83), but recurrence was higher for biceps femoris than semimembranosus and semitendinosus combined (18% vs 2%, p=0.009).
Oedema size weakly correlated with time to RTP (r2=6-12%); no correlation was found between injury location or injury type and time to RTP.
key_points_pt: Análise prospetiva de 255 lesões dos isquiotibiais de grau 1 e 2 em futebolistas profissionais masculinos (46 equipas europeias de elite, 2007-2014), com RM avaliada por dois radiologistas independentes.
O tempo até ao regresso à competição foi maior nas lesões de grau 2 do que nas de grau 1 (24±13 vs 18±15 dias; diferença média de 6 dias, IC 95% 2 a 9, p=0,004).

84% das lesões envolveram o bicípite femoral; o tempo de paragem não diferiu entre os três músculos (p=0,83), mas a recidiva foi superior no bicípite femoral do que no semimembranoso e semitendinoso em conjunto (18% vs 2%, p=0,009).
A dimensão do edema correlacionou-se fracamente com o tempo até ao regresso (r2=6-12%); não se encontrou correlação entre a localização ou o tipo de lesão e o tempo até ao regresso.
abstract_excerpt: METHODS: 46 elite European football teams were followed prospectively for hamstring injuries between 2007 and 2014. Club medical staff recorded individual player exposure and time-loss after hamstring injury. MRI parameters were evaluated by two independent radiologists and correlated with the RTP data. RESULTS: A total of 255 grade 1 and 2 injuries were evaluated in this study. RTP was longer for grade 2 than grade 1 injuries (24±13, 95% CI 21 to 26 days vs 18±15, 95% CI 16 to 20 days; mean difference: 6, 95% CI 2 to 9 days, p=0.004, d=0.39). 84% of injuries affected the biceps femoris (BF) muscle, whereas 12% and 4% affected the semimembranosus (SM) and semitendinosus (ST), respectively. No difference in lay-off time was found for injuries to the three different muscles (BF 20±15 days, SM 18±11 days, ST 23±14 days; p=0.83). The recurrence rate was higher for BF injuries than for SM and ST injuries combined (18% vs 2%, p=0.009). The size of the oedema weakly correlated with time to RTP (r(2)=6-12%). No correlation was found between location of injury and time to RTP. The majority of the intramuscular injuries affected the MT junction (56% in grade 1 and 2 injuries), but no difference in lay-off time was found between the different types of injuries.

topic: Hamstring injury: diagnostic and prognostic value of ultrasound in soccer
title: The diagnostic and prognostic value of ultrasonography in soccer players with acute hamstring injuries.
journal: The American Journal of Sports Medicine
key_points: Case series (level of evidence 4) of 51 soccer players with acute hamstring injury examined with ultrasound 1 to 10 days after injury (mean 5.2 ± 3.0 days); sonographic findings were present in 31 of 51 cases (61%).
Two thirds of injuries involved the biceps femoris and one third the semitendinosus; no total ruptures were documented.

Mean absence was 25.4 ± 15.7 days, with no significant difference between players with and without sonographic abnormalities (P = .41); length of the injured area did not correlate with severity (r = 0.19, P = .29).
Authors conclude hamstring injury prognosis should not be guided by sonographic findings alone.
key_points_pt: Série de casos (nível de evidência 4) de 51 futebolistas com lesão aguda dos isquiotibiais avaliados por ecografia 1 a 10 dias após a lesão (média 5,2 ± 3,0 dias); houve achados ecográficos em 31 de 51 casos (61%).
Dois terços das lesões envolveram o bicípite femoral e um terço o semitendinoso; não foram documentadas roturas totais.

A ausência média foi de 25,4 ± 15,7 dias, sem diferença significativa entre jogadores com e sem alterações ecográficas (P = 0,41); o comprimento da área lesada não se correlacionou com a gravidade (r = 0,19, P = 0,29).
Os autores concluem que o prognóstico das lesões dos isquiotibiais não deve basear-se apenas nos achados ecográficos.
abstract_excerpt: Of 67 players with acute hamstring injuries, 51 underwent ultrasonographic examination of the injured thigh and were included in this study. RESULTS: Ultrasonographic examinations were performed 1 to 10 days after injury (mean, 5.2 ± 3.0 days), and sonographic findings were present in 31 of 51 cases (61%). Two thirds of the injuries were to the biceps femoris muscle and one third to the semitendinosus muscle. No total ruptures were documented. The 51 acute hamstring injuries resulted in absence from soccer of a mean 25.4 ± 15.7 days per injury, with no significant difference between players with and without sonographically verified abnormalities (P = .41). No correlation existed between the length of the injured area and injury severity (r = 0.19, P = .29). CONCLUSION: The biceps femoris is the most commonly injured hamstring muscle detected by ultrasound, and more than half of the injuries are intramuscular. Because neither the presence of sonographic findings nor the size of the findings was correlated with time to return to play in injured soccer players, the prognosis of hamstring injuries should not be guided by these findings alone.

topic: Achilles tendon rupture: ultrasound diagnostic accuracy vs surgery (meta-analysis)
title: Diagnosing Achilles Tendon Rupture with Ultrasound in Patients Treated Surgically: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
key_points: 15 studies with 808 patients, using surgery as the reference standard.
For complete Achilles tendon rupture, ultrasound sensitivity was 94.8% (95% CI 91.3-97.2%) and specificity 98.7% (95% CI 97.0-99.6%).
Positive likelihood ratio 74.0 (95% CI 31.0-176.8); negative likelihood ratio 0.05 (95% CI 0.03-0.09).

Authors suggest a negative ultrasound result may have the potential to rule out a complete, as well as a partial, rupture (the pooled estimates reported are for complete ruptures). Background: up to 20% of ruptures are misdiagnosed, most commonly as ankle sprain.
key_points_pt: 15 estudos com 808 doentes, com a cirurgia como padrão de referência.
Na rotura completa do tendão de Aquiles, a ecografia teve sensibilidade de 94,8% (IC 95% 91,3-97,2%) e especificidade de 98,7% (IC 95% 97,0-99,6%).
Razão de verosimilhança positiva 74,0 (IC 95% 31,0-176,8); razão de verosimilhança negativa 0,05 (IC 95% 0,03-0,09).

Os autores sugerem que uma ecografia negativa poderá permitir excluir rotura completa e também parcial (as estimativas agregadas apresentadas referem-se a roturas completas). Contexto: até 20% das roturas são mal diagnosticadas, mais frequentemente como entorse do tornozelo.
abstract_excerpt: The diagnosis can often be missed or delayed, with up to 20% misdiagnosed, most commonly as an ankle sprain. [...] RESULTS: A total of 15 studies with 808 patients were included in the primary analysis. The sensitivity of ultrasound for detecting complete Achilles tendon ruptures was 94.8% (95% confidence interval [CI] 91.3-97.2%), specificity was 98.7% (95% CI 97.0-99.6%), positive likelihood ratio was 74.0 (95% CI 31.0-176.8), and negative likelihood ratio was 0.05 (95% CI 0.03-0.09), in patients who underwent surgical treatment. CONCLUSIONS: The results from our study suggested that a negative ultrasound result may have the potential to rule out a complete, as well as a partial, Achilles tendon rupture.

topic: Achilles and patellar tendinopathy: predictive value of ultrasound abnormalities in asymptomatic athletes (meta-analysis)
title: Sonographic Assessment of Asymptomatic Patellar and Achilles Tendons to Predict Future Pain: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
key_points: 16 studies (prospective studies were required for inclusion) including 810 Achilles and 1156 patellar tendons in athletes without tendon pain at baseline.
Risk ratio for pain development with abnormal ultrasound: patellar tendon 6.07 (95% CI 2.88-12.81); Achilles tendon 3.96 (95% CI 2.21-7.09).
Positive and negative predictive values of an abnormal ultrasound finding: 27.2% and 92.0% (Achilles); 27.2% and 93.5% (patellar).
Ultrasound of asymptomatic Achilles or patellar tendons has a low positive but high negative predictive value for future pain.
key_points_pt: 16 estudos (a inclusão exigia desenho prospetivo) com 810 tendões de Aquiles e 1156 tendões rotulianos em atletas sem dor tendinosa no início.
Risco relativo de desenvolver dor com ecografia alterada: tendão rotuliano 6,07 (IC 95% 2,88-12,81); tendão de Aquiles 3,96 (IC 95% 2,21-7,09).
Valores preditivos positivo e negativo de um achado ecográfico alterado: 27,2% e 92,0% (Aquiles); 27,2% e 93,5% (rotuliano).
A ecografia de tendões de Aquiles ou rotulianos assintomáticos tem baixo valor preditivo positivo mas elevado valor preditivo negativo para dor futura.
abstract_excerpt: Inclusion criteria were as follows: prospective studies of Achilles and patellar tendon pain development with baseline US measurements, follow-up clinical measurements, and English-language studies published after 2000. [...] PATIENTS: Athletes without Achilles or patellar tendon pain at baseline. [...] RESULTS: This review of 16 studies included 810 Achilles and 1156 patellar tendons from a variety of sports and demonstrated that the RR for pain development from abnormal Patellar and Achilles tendons was 6.07 [95% confidence interval (CI), 2.88-12.81; P < 0.001] and 3.96 [95% CI, 2.21-7.09; P < 0.001], respectively. The positive and negative predictive values of an abnormal US finding were 27.2% and 92.0% for the Achilles tendon and 27.2% and 93.5% for the patellar tendon, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: This systematic review and meta-analysis identified that the use of asymptomatic US scanning of the Achilles or patellar tendon has a low positive predictive value but a high negative predictive value for the future development of pain.

topic: Patellar tendinopathy: comparative accuracy of ultrasound (grey-scale and colour Doppler) and MRI
title: Comparative accuracy of magnetic resonance imaging and ultrasonography in confirming clinically diagnosed patellar tendinopathy.
journal: The American Journal of Sports Medicine
key_points: Prospective comparison of 30 participants with clinically diagnosed patellar tendinopathy and 33 activity-matched asymptomatic participants.
Accuracy: MRI 70%, grey-scale US 83%, colour Doppler US 83% (P = .04, MRI vs grey-scale US).
Grey-scale US sensitivity was greater than MRI (87% vs 57%; P = .01), with equivalent specificity (82% vs 82%).

Colour Doppler US: sensitivity 70% and specificity 94%, not significantly different from grey-scale US (P = .06 and P = .10); positive likelihood ratio 11.6 (vs 4.8 grey-scale US, 3.1 MRI); a positive colour Doppler result indicated a strong likelihood the individual was symptomatic.
key_points_pt: Comparação prospetiva de 30 participantes com tendinopatia rotuliana diagnosticada clinicamente e 33 participantes assintomáticos com nível de atividade semelhante.
Exatidão: RM 70%, ecografia em escala de cinzentos 83%, ecografia com Doppler a cores 83% (P = 0,04, RM vs ecografia em escala de cinzentos).
A sensibilidade da ecografia em escala de cinzentos foi superior à da RM (87% vs 57%; P = 0,01), com especificidade equivalente (82% vs 82%).

Doppler a cores: sensibilidade 70% e especificidade 94%, sem diferença significativa face à escala de cinzentos (P = 0,06 e P = 0,10); razão de verosimilhança positiva 11,6 (vs 4,8 na escala de cinzentos e 3,1 na RM); um Doppler a cores positivo indicou forte probabilidade de o indivíduo ser sintomático.
abstract_excerpt: RESULTS: The accuracy of MRI, GS-US, and CD-US was 70%, 83%, and 83%, respectively (P = .04; MRI vs GS-US). The likelihood of positive MRI, GS-US, and CD-US was 3.1, 4.8, and 11.6, respectively. The MRI and GS-US had equivalent specificity (82% vs 82%; P = 1.00); however, the sensitivity of GS-US was greater than MRI (87% vs 57%; P = .01). Sensitivity (70% vs 87%; P = .06) and specificity (94% vs 82%; P = .10) did not differ between CD-US and GS-US. CONCLUSIONS: Ultrasonography was more accurate than MRI in confirming clinically diagnosed patellar tendinopathy. GS-US and CD-US may represent the best combination for confirming clinically diagnosed patellar tendinopathy because GS-US had the greatest sensitivity, while a positive CD-US test result indicated a strong likelihood an individual was symptomatic.

topic: Plantar fasciitis / chronic plantar heel pain: plantar fascia thickness on ultrasound (meta-analysis)
title: Diagnostic imaging for chronic plantar heel pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
journal: Journal of Foot and Ankle Research
key_points: 23 studies identified; plantar fascia thickness on ultrasound was the most widely reported imaging feature, and in chronic plantar heel pain the fascia was 2.16 mm thicker than in controls (95% CI 1.60 to 2.71 mm, P < 0.001).
Patients were more likely to have plantar fascia thickness greater than 4.0 mm (OR 105.11, 95% CI 3.09 to 3577.28, P = 0.01).

Authors concluded that people with chronic plantar heel pain are likely to have a thickened plantar fascia with associated fluid collection, and that thickness values >4.0 mm are diagnostic of plantar fasciitis.
Radiographic subcalcaneal spur was more likely than in controls (OR 8.52, 95% CI 4.08 to 17.77, P < 0.001).
key_points_pt: Foram identificados 23 estudos; a espessura da fáscia plantar na ecografia foi o achado imagiológico mais reportado, e na talalgia plantar crónica a fáscia era 2,16 mm mais espessa do que nos controlos (IC 95% 1,60 a 2,71 mm, P < 0,001).
Os doentes tinham maior probabilidade de espessura da fáscia plantar superior a 4,0 mm (OR 105,11, IC 95% 3,09 a 3577,28, P = 0,01).

Os autores concluíram que os doentes com talalgia plantar crónica tendem a ter fáscia plantar espessada com coleção líquida associada, e que valores de espessura >4,0 mm são diagnósticos de fasciite plantar.
O esporão subcalcaneano na radiografia foi mais frequente do que nos controlos (OR 8,52, IC 95% 4,08 a 17,77, P < 0,001).
abstract_excerpt: RESULTS: Plantar fascia thickness as measured by ultrasonography was the most widely reported imaging feature. Meta-analysis revealed that the plantar fascia of CPHP participants was 2.16 mm thicker than control participants (95% CI = 1.60 to 2.71 mm, P < 0.001) and that CPHP participants were more likely to have plantar fascia thickness values greater than 4.0 mm (OR = 105.11, 95% CI = 3.09 to 3577.28, P = 0.01). CPHP participants were also more likely to show radiographic evidence of subcalcaneal spur than control participants (OR = 8.52, 95% CI = 4.08 to 17.77, P < 0.001). CONCLUSION: This systematic review has identified 23 studies investigating the diagnostic imaging appearance of the plantar fascia and inferior calcaneum in people with CPHP. Analysis of these studies found that people with CPHP are likely to have a thickened plantar fascia with associated fluid collection, and that thickness values >4.0 mm are diagnostic of plantar fasciitis.

topic: Lateral ankle sprain: ultrasound accuracy for anterior talofibular ligament (ATFL) tear vs operative findings (meta-analysis)
title: Ankle ultrasound for detecting anterior talofibular ligament tear using operative finding as reference standard: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
journal: European Journal of Trauma and Emergency Surgery
key_points: 10 studies with operative findings as reference standard.
Pooled diagnostic accuracy of ankle ultrasound for ATFL tear was 0.95 (95% CI 0.88-0.98); acute tears 0.92 (95% CI 0.85-0.95); chronic tears 0.96 (95% CI 0.84-0.99).
Pooled accuracy for complete and partial ATFL tears was 0.82 (95% CI 0.72-0.89) and 0.88 (95% CI 0.70-0.96), respectively.
A high-frequency probe and sufficient examiner experience are described as mandatory for correct diagnosis.
key_points_pt: 10 estudos com os achados cirúrgicos como padrão de referência.

A exatidão diagnóstica agregada da ecografia para rotura do ligamento talofibular anterior (LTFA) foi 0,95 (IC 95% 0,88-0,98); roturas agudas 0,92 (IC 95% 0,85-0,95); roturas crónicas 0,96 (IC 95% 0,84-0,99).
A exatidão agregada para roturas completas e parciais do LTFA foi 0,82 (IC 95% 0,72-0,89) e 0,88 (IC 95% 0,70-0,96), respetivamente.
Uma sonda de alta frequência e experiência suficiente do examinador são descritas como indispensáveis para o diagnóstico correto.
abstract_excerpt: RESULTS: Ten studies were included. The pooled proportion of the diagnostic accuracy of ankle ultrasound for ATFL was 0.95 (95% confidence interval [CI] 0.88-0.98). In subgroup analysis, the pooled proportion of the diagnostic accuracy of ankle ultrasound for acute ATFL tear was 0.92 (95% CI 0.85-0.95). The pooled proportion of the diagnostic accuracy of ankle ultrasound for chronic ATFL tear was 0.96 (95% CI 0.84-0.99). The pooled proportions of the diagnostic accuracy for complete and partial ATFL tear were 0.82 (95% CI 0.72-0.89) and 0.88 (95% CI 0.70-0.96), respectively. [...] For correct diagnosis of ATFL tear, a high-frequency ultrasound probe and sufficient experience of the examiner are mandatory.

topic: Baker's (popliteal) cyst: sonographic diagnostic criterion vs MRI
title: Sonographic detection of Baker's cysts: comparison with MR imaging.
key_points: 36 consecutive knees (36 patients) evaluated with both MRI (gold standard) and ultrasound; MRI showed 21 Baker's cysts, one myxoid liposarcoma, one meniscal cyst and 13 normal examinations.
Hypoechoic or anechoic fluid between the semimembranosus and medial gastrocnemius tendons gave 100% sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV and accuracy for Baker's cyst on retrospective image review.
In the original sonography reports, all 21 Baker's cysts were correctly diagnosed, but the meniscal cyst and the myxoid liposarcoma were misdiagnosed as Baker's cysts.
No other sonographic characteristics were significant.
key_points_pt: 36 joelhos consecutivos (36 doentes) avaliados por RM (padrão de referência) e ecografia; a RM mostrou 21 quistos de Baker, um lipossarcoma mixoide, um quisto meniscal e 13 exames normais.

Líquido hipoecogénico ou anecogénico entre os tendões do semimembranoso e do gastrocnémio medial teve 100% de sensibilidade, especificidade, VPP, VPN e exatidão para quisto de Baker na revisão retrospetiva das imagens.
Nos relatórios ecográficos originais, os 21 quistos de Baker foram corretamente diagnosticados, mas o quisto meniscal e o lipossarcoma mixoide foram erradamente diagnosticados como quistos de Baker.
Nenhuma outra característica ecográfica foi significativa.
abstract_excerpt: MATERIALS AND METHODS: The study group consisted of 36 consecutive knees in 36 patients evaluated with both MR imaging and sonography. [...] RESULTS: Retrospective review of MR images revealed 21 Baker's cysts, one myxoid liposarcoma, one meniscal cyst, and 13 examinations with normal findings. The sonography reports revealed that the 21 Baker's cysts were correctly diagnosed, whereas the meniscal cyst and myxoid liposarcoma were misdiagnosed as Baker's cysts. Retrospective review of sonographic images showed a 100% sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and accuracy in the diagnosis of Baker's cyst when hypoechoic or anechoic fluid was present between the semimembranosus and medial gastrocnemius tendons. No other sonographic characteristics were significant.

topic: Traumatic knee injury: radiographic suprapatellar effusion size and internal derangement on MRI
title: Traumatic knee injury: correlation of radiographic effusion size with the presence of internal derangement on magnetic resonance imaging.
key_points: Retrospective review of 198 patients aged 18-40 years with acute knee injury, correlating suprapatellar effusion diameter on lateral radiograph with internal derangement on MRI.
Radiographic effusion size correlated positively with internal derangement on MRI (logistic regression, p < 0.001).
Using >10 mm as a positive test: sensitivity 55%, specificity 96%, PPV 93%, NPV 71%, accuracy 77%.
Authors suggest that, in this population, radiographic effusion >10 mm should prompt consideration of knee MRI.
key_points_pt: Revisão retrospetiva de 198 doentes com 18-40 anos e traumatismo agudo do joelho, correlacionando o diâmetro do derrame suprarrotuliano na radiografia de perfil com lesão interna na RM.
A dimensão do derrame na radiografia correlacionou-se positivamente com lesão interna na RM (regressão logística, p < 0,001).
Com limiar >10 mm como teste positivo: sensibilidade 55%, especificidade 96%, VPP 93%, VPN 71%, exatidão 77%.
Os autores sugerem que, nesta população, um derrame >10 mm na radiografia deve motivar a ponderação de RM do joelho.
abstract_excerpt: RESULTS: Logistic regression showed a positive correlation between radiographic effusion size and the presence of internal derangement on magnetic resonance exams (p value < 0.001). Radiographic effusion > 10 mm was established as a positive test, yielding test sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and accuracy of 55, 96, 93, 71, and 77%, respectively. [...] In this patient population, knee effusion > 10 mm on lateral radiograph should prompt consideration for knee magnetic resonance examination.

topic: Hip joint effusion/synovitis: ultrasound femoral neck-capsule distance
title: Hip joint ultrasonography: correlation with intra-articular effusion and synovitis.
key_points: Ultrasound distance between the femoral neck (collum) and the hip joint capsule was measured in 88 hips of 75 patients with chronic inflammatory joint disease and hip symptoms or signs, plus 10 hips before soft tissue surgery.
The distance was 7 mm or more in 29 of 33 hips with synovial fluid at joint puncture and in 7 of 9 hips with intra-articular effusion or synovitis at open surgery.
Both joint effusion and synovitis without effusion can increase the anechogenic bone-capsule distance.
Intra-articular corticosteroid injection significantly decreased an enlarged distance, in joints with and without synovial fluid; untreated joints showed no change.
key_points_pt: Mediu-se por ecografia a distância entre o colo do fémur e a cápsula da articulação coxofemoral em 88 ancas de 75 doentes com doença articular inflamatória crónica e sintomas ou sinais na anca, e em 10 ancas antes de cirurgia de partes moles.
A distância foi igual ou superior a 7 mm em 29 de 33 ancas com líquido sinovial na punção articular e em 7 de 9 ancas com derrame intra-articular ou sinovite na cirurgia aberta.
Tanto o derrame articular como a sinovite sem derrame podem aumentar a distância anecogénica entre o osso e a cápsula.
A infiltração intra-articular de corticosteroide reduziu significativamente a distância aumentada, em articulações com e sem líquido sinovial; as articulações não tratadas não mostraram alteração.
abstract_excerpt: The ultrasonographic distance between the collum of the femur and the capsule of the hip joint was measured in 88 hips of 75 patients with chronic inflammatory joint disease and with hip joint symptoms or signs. In addition, 10 other hips were measured before soft tissue operation of the hip joint. The ultrasonographic distance was 7 mm or more in 29 out of 33 hips with synovial fluid in joint puncture and in seven out of nine hips with intra-articular effusion or synovitis in open surgery.
